blocks.text: Thermochemistry woh ilm hai jis mein hum parhte hain ke physical ya chemical change ke dauran kitni heat energy absorb (jazb) hoti hai ya evolve hoti (bahar nikalti) hai. Isi liye ise energetics bhi kehte hain, aur yeh zyada tar thermodynamics ke first law par based hai. Hess’ law, jo first law ka hi ek special case (khas soorat) hai, chemist ke haath mein ek bohat kaam ka tool (auzaar) hai aur analytical chemistry mein is ke bohat se istemal hain. Thermodynamics yeh bhi batati hai ke koi reaction di gayi conditions mein ho sakta hai ya nahi, yani reaction ki spontaneity (khud ba khud hone ki salahiyat).

blocks.title: Heat content ya enthalpy
blocks.text: Kisi substance ke andar jo energy us ki structure (bonds ki type) aur physical state ki wajah se hoti hai, use us ka heat content ya enthalpy kehte hain. Is ka symbol H hai.

Har substance ki apni ek khas enthalpy hoti hai. Isi liye products ki total enthalpy (HP) kabhi reactants ki total enthalpy (HR) ke barabar nahi hoti. Jab reaction mein reactants products ban jate hain to enthalpy badal jati hai; is change ko ΔH kehte hain. Easy words mein, enthalpy change woh total energy hai jo heat ki shakal mein ya to bahar nikalti hai ya andar absorb hoti hai.

blocks.latex: \Delta H = (\text{Heat content of products, } H_P) - (\text{Heat content of reactants, } H_R)
blocks.text_alt: ΔH = (Heat content of products, HP) – (Heat content of reactants, HR)

blocks.text: i. HP < HR: enthalpy kam ho jati hai, is liye heat bahar nikalti hai (HP – HR ke barabar) aur ΔH ka sign negative (manfi) hota hai.

blocks.title: Exothermic process
blocks.text: Woh chemical reaction ya physical change jis mein heat system se nikal kar surroundings (aas paas ke mahol) mein jati hai, exothermic process kehlata hai.
ii. HP > HR: enthalpy barh jati hai, is liye heat absorb hoti hai (HP – HR ke barabar) aur ΔH ka sign positive (musbat) hota hai.

blocks.title: Endothermic process
blocks.text: Woh chemical reaction ya physical change jis mein system surroundings se heat absorb karta hai, endothermic process kehlata hai.
Figure 6.1 mein exothermic aur endothermic reactions ke enthalpy diagrams dikhaye gaye hain.

blocks.alt: Do enthalpy diagrams. (a) Enthalpy axis par HR oopar aur HP neeche; HR par neela 'reactants' level, wahan se laal arrow neeche HP par neele 'products' level tak, saath likha: chunke HR > HP, is liye delta H = negative (manfi). (b) HR neeche aur HP oopar; laal arrow 'reactants' se oopar 'products' tak, saath likha: chunke HR < HP, is liye delta H = positive (musbat). Dono ka x-axis 'Progress of Reaction' hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.1: (a) Exothermic aur (b) endothermic reaction ka enthalpy diagram (kitab ki Figure 6.1 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein reactants ki line (HR) oopar aur products ki line (HP) neeche hai, is liye arrow neeche ki taraf hai: heat bahar nikli, ΔH negative. (b) mein reactants neeche aur products oopar hain, arrow oopar ki taraf hai: heat absorb hui, ΔH positive.
Misal: carbon ka oxygen mein jalna (combustion) exothermic reaction hai.

blocks.text_alt: C(s) + O₂(g) → CO₂(g)    ΔH = –393.7 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) ka pani mein ghulna (dissolution) endothermic process hai.

blocks.text_alt: NH₄Cl(s) —H₂O(l)→ NH₄⁺(aq) + Cl⁻(aq)    ΔH = +16.2 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.title: Interesting information (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) ka pani mein ghulna endothermic reaction hai. Yeh cold packs (ice packs) mein istemal hota hai jin se internal injuries (andar ki chotein) ka ilaj kiya jata hai. Pack ko dabane se pani aur NH₄Cl ke crystals mil jate hain, surroundings se energy absorb hoti hai aur thandak mehsoos hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Exothermic reaction mein HR aur HP mein se kaun bara hai, aur farq wali energy kahan jati hai?
blocks.explanation: HR (reactants ki enthalpy) bari hoti hai. Farq HP – HR negative hai; yeh energy heat ban kar system se surroundings mein chali jati hai, is liye mixture garam ho jata hai.

items: Thermochemistry (energetics) absorb ya evolve hone wali heat ka study hai; yeh thermodynamics ke first law par based hai aur Hess’ law us ka special case hai.
ΔH = HP – HR. Exothermic: HP < HR, ΔH negative, heat bahar (C + O₂ → CO₂, –393.7 kJ mol⁻¹).
Endothermic: HP > HR, ΔH positive, heat andar (NH₄Cl ka ghulna, +16.2 kJ mol⁻¹, cold packs).
